verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows CockroachDB as a distributed, strongly-consistent OLTP SQL database (ACID transactions, scaling, backups, vector indexes) but contains no evidence of columnar storage, vectorized execution, or any analytical/OLAP acceleration features that would make heavy aggregations over large tables fast enough for dashboards. Nothing in docs or community discussion addresses analytical query performance or HTAP-style capabilities that would obviate a separate warehouse.
